controller_diagnostics.policy_origin: learned movement head with authored phase/contact/gripper supervisor
controller_diagnostics.recovery_scope: at most one resettled upright, axis-aligned box on the same table
controller_diagnostics.command_rate_scope: native-tick target ramp before gravity feedforward; actual velocity is measured separately

network_guard.scope: Python socket calls during rollouts/training after dependency imports; not native C or installation

limitations: Hybrid controller: joint-movement mapping distilled from authored simulator demonstrations; phases, grasp and recovery remain authored.
One original arm profile, privileged simulator observations, rigid box proxy for placement skills.
Native jaw/object/table contacts; arm links and palm are collision-excluded.
No camera perception, physical arm calibration, selfcollision, cup/handle, cable tying or broad skill qualification.
Installation may fetch one public JSON envelope; installed execution and replay can run offline.
timing_scope: Episode wall clock includes model compilation, reset/settling, IK/controller, native physics, observations and traces; excludes installation, web UI, process startup and output I/O. No GPU benchmark.
policy_origin: learned joint-movement head with authored task phases, grasp and recovery
